Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the AIIMS Jodhpur recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive is Research Assistant. AIIMS Jodhpur is looking for eligible candidates to fill this position through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Assistant post at AIIMS Jodhpur. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the walk-in interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Assistant post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 31,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Graduate degree in Medical Sciences, or a Graduate degree in Science/relevant subjects with three years of work experience, or a Master's degree in Public Health.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Assistant position will be held on 15 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at AIIMS Jodhpur, Rajasthan. Specific venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original documents and self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant post will be based on a Walk-in Interview.
